name: Goi ca thoi loi
summary: Gỏi cá thòi lòi trộn lá lìm kìm is the mudskipper salad Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The fish is a white goby that lives in the mangrove, climbs trees, and runs on the mud. The flesh is sweet, fragrant, and soft. The story prints the leaf and the sauce, and does not print how the fish is cooked. VnExpress describes a different leaf salad, with fried cá bống sao.
howToEat: Pick young lá lìm kìm, take off the stems, wash, and drain. The leaf is sour and a little astringent, so the sauce is a bit sweet. Mix nước mắm with tomato, pour it on the leaves, and add fried shallot and chili.
Dân Việt says the salad is better with rượu mật ong rừng Sác. It does not print how the mudskipper is cooked. Check on arrival.
